user.title: Server Room Climate Controller
user.description: Observation by default. Configure the command profile, then enable the SRCC automatic control switch. The automatic control choice is saved across restart and reload; equipment feedback is checked again before commands. Backup sensors are independently optional. Timing settings must match source entity updates.

data.backup_max_skew: Maximum time difference between backup readings
data.recovery_max_gap: Maximum gap in critical recovery measurements
data.recovery_hold: Critical recovery duration with falling temperature
data.ac_hard_min: AC minimum outdoor temperature (start forbidden at or below)
data.reported_freshness_confirmed: Use HA publication age for observation; I understand this does not prove physical device freshness
data.control_profile_enabled: Enable command capability (automation switch starts OFF)
data.equipment_readback_confirmed: Equipment states are confirmed readbacks; C.dr 0 permits manual output control and 1 restores automatic control
data.shared_mains_confirmed: AC and UPS share mains; AC has no backup supply and powers its communication controller
data.emergency_delta: Minimum indoor minus outdoor difference for backup fan
data.emergency_outdoor_max: Backup fan outdoor limit (blocked at or above)
data.minimum_vent_rise: Minimum rise over ventilation observation window (optional)
data.minimum_dwell: Minimum time between normal cooling changes
data.minimum_ac_off: Minimum wait before starting stopped AC

error.invalid_entity: An entity has an unsupported domain or identifier.
error.duplicate_entity: Use distinct entities for different roles.
error.invalid_timing: Enter finite positive age/gap limits and nonnegative tolerances; sampling tolerance must be below 60 seconds.
error.invalid_thresholds: Check the temperature thresholds and recovery duration.
error.entity_not_found: A selected entity is not present in HA.
error.invalid_temperature_unit: Temperature units must be Celsius, Fahrenheit or Kelvin.
error.self_reference: SRCC outputs cannot be used as SRCC inputs.
error.invalid_execution: Check finite command settings and positive timeout.
error.missing_control_entities: Control requires climate, writable ventilation permission and output, and both UPS signals.
error.control_entities_not_writable: Ventilation permission must be number or switch; fan output must be switch.
error.missing_control_settings: Enter AC target and backup fan ON/OFF temperatures and minimum temperature difference.
error.control_readback_required: Confirm tested equipment readback before enabling the command profile.
error.invalid_haier_result_topic: Enter the exact PREFIX/result topic without MQTT wildcards.
error.haier_device_mismatch: Telemetry and climate must belong to the same Haier MQTT device.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one controller is supported in this release.
